selection: Causal FAST absolute-return movement; causal rolling 24-hour quote volume breaks ties
execution: Decision after close; next-minute recorded VWAP plus slippage; fill-or-kill at 1% of recorded quote volume
identity: One active position per normalized base asset; position IDs never reused
replacement: Distinct inactive candidates are linked to the exact exit; no replacement can fill before its exit or after another fallback fills the same slot
replacement_funding: Up to the exact released exit proceeds may seed its linked replacement without being classified as new exposure
integrity_gates: All 4,320 minutes present for every asset
No simultaneous duplicate normalized base asset
No active position below 10 quote basis
No negative cash or double spending
Realized and unrealized P&L reported separately
evidence_class: Recorded OHLCV with estimated execution; not recorded bid/ask or order-book depth
